title: Zephyr: Rule 6 compression
description: Implement current-spec Rule 6 global Yggdrasil IPv6 + UDP + OSCORE CoAP compression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: canonical selector/encoding, strict bounds and atomic failures, shared-vector cross-validation.
notes: The original EDHOC description was stale: current spec draft, canonical schc_compression.json, Python, and Rust all define Rule 6 as global Yggdrasil OSCORE. Implemented Rule 6 by sharing the canonical v3 global CoAP encoder with Rule 1 while preserving distinct rule IDs and strict OSCORE selection. It emits the 286-bit/36-byte residue (hop, 120-bit address suffixes under exact 0x02/8 prefixes, 4-bit CoAP port suffixes, CoAP fixed fields), validates zero TC/flow, TKL/token availability, IPv6/UDP lengths, nonzero correct UDP checksum, caller capacity, and the 22,554-byte profile limit before the first output write. The shared RFC 8613 selector accepts only one valid OSCORE option; absent/malformed/duplicate options remain Rule 1, while valid OSCORE that misses Rule 6 address/port/fixed constraints cannot be mislabeled plaintext and falls back to Rule 255. Added isolated lichen/tests/schc_rule6_compress coverage for byte-exact canonical Python-oracle vector, independent extreme packing, valid and malformed OSCORE forms, Yggdrasil/port/TC constraints, checksum and output atomicity, and exact 22,554 acceptance / 22,555 rejection. Validation: strict host C build + UBSan ctest passed 1/1; Python test_rule6.py 18 passed; isolated Rust rule6_compression 7 passed; focused cppcheck and git diff --check clean.
close_reason: Current-spec global OSCORE Rule 6 compression implemented atomically and cross-validated against canonical C/Python/Rust vectors.
